title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Premium Payment, Renewal and Cancellation Servicing Settings
content:
## NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Premium Payment, Renewal and Cancellation Servicing Settings

Tidemark's policy and claims desk services NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) under the figures below. Where FEMA leaves a cadence to the Write Your Own company (such as the renewal bill lead time) the figure is Tidemark's own written servicing schedule.

| Item | Tenant Contents | Residential Condominium Unit | Manufactured Home | Secondary Single-Family Home | Primary Single-Family Home | Two-to-Four Unit Building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full term premium must accompany the application or renewal (no installments) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days the policyholder has to pay an underpayment after Tidemark's notice before limits are reduced (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Payment methods Tidemark accepts on NFIP premium | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| Days before expiration Tidemark issues the renewal bill (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Grace period after expiration in which the full renewal premium keeps coverage continuous (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Renewal bill also sent to the mortgagee of record when the policy is mortgage-required | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A cancellation needs the named insured's signed cancellation request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge come back on a pro rata or current-term refund | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Rounding applied to each refunded component, half-up (USD) | 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.01 |
| Days before receipt of the signed request that a voluntary, mortgage-payoff or private-replacement cancellation may take effect (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Days a cancelled or non-renewed policy stays in force for the mortgagee only after Tidemark notifies it (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

### Notes

- Premium is payable in full for the term on every tier; no installment plan exists.
- The renewal bill is issued 45 calendar days before expiration and the renewal grace period is 30 calendar days after expiration.
- Each refunded component is rounded half-up to 0.01 dollar, that is, to the cent.
- A voluntary, mortgage-payoff or private-replacement cancellation may reach back 0 days before the signed request is received, which means it can take effect no earlier than the receipt date of that request.
- After Tidemark notifies the mortgagee of a cancellation or non-renewal, the policy continues for the mortgagee only for 30 calendar days.
